name: Alkosto
body: Organization and store JSON-LD, a meta description on every page analyzed, HSTS, and DMARC that guards its mail. But 184 of the 195 images on the home page carry no width or height, so the layout jumps as they load.
lesson: Set width and height on every img, or an aspect-ratio in CSS. The browser then reserves the space early.
summary: www.alkosto.com scores 78 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: 33 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 33 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /ofertas/c/ofertas, /sigue-tu-pedido, /nuestra-compania/tiendas and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, ChatGPT-User cannot read 1 page, Claude-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, Claude-User cannot read 1 page.
fix.fix: Check that the closed paths are meant to stay out of AI answers.

fix.title: 184 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 6 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / WebSite lacks name, /nuestra-compania/tiendas WebSite lacks name, /preguntas-frecuentes WebSite lacks name and 3 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.
